blocks.x: Well, did you hurt him much?
He was cut from the -- right in front of his ear all the way down to his chin, you know, and --
It is really the danger of carrying a knife.
Yeah, you go for it. You go for it on the least little thing. When you don't have it, you going to find another way out, you know.
Well, I mean, you know, you -- everybody loses his temper some time or other, and if you're carrying something like that --
-- you're liable to go for it.

I always remember, you know, Cat Anderson blowing in Tizol's ear, thought Tizol was playing around and he kept blowing the notes in his ear, and Tizol whipped out his knife. This was when they were recording with Basie. And everybody thought it was very funny. Of course, it could have been dangerous.

Yeah. Yeah, you know, that's a hurting thing for somebody to do that in your ear anyway, you know. It seems like he's asking for something. Well, it was the same thing, you know. See, I made a contract with McShann when I didn't go with -- with --
